name: thread-bolt-and-nut
why: A printed M8 pair: a bolt and a 13 x 13 x 8 nut, each with 0.2 mm clearance, in phase (the bolt's end and the nut's face whole pitches from the tooth's origin). Closed forms, derived in the script: bolt 738.740412 mm3, nut 983.731029 mm3 (exact B-rep reads 738.74 and 983.73 through probe_step_export; the recorded volumes are the meshes'). The flank gap: a radial shift c on each part is c/2 across a 30-degree flank, c in total, shortened by the lead angle to c (2/sqrt3) / sqrt(4/3 + (P/2 pi r)^2) = 0.19976 mm at the nut's crest, which between_bodies reads as 0.200 and clear. The same nut 0.4 of a pitch out of phase reads interfering.
